title: El Niño Watch: Angat Dam may dip to 180 meters by end of February — PAGASA
summary: The water level at Angat Dam may reach its minimum operating level of 180 meters by the end of February 2027 due to the prevailing El Niño, PAGASA said in a climate forum on Wednesday.
